Remind them why. | id = MaceSilver | type = Club 1h | source = [[Forge]] | durability = 200 | crafting level = 3 | repair level = 3 | blunt = 35 | frost = 40 | spirit = 20 | knockback = 100 | materials 1 = * [[Ancient Bark]] x10 * [[Silver]] x30 * [[Ymir Flesh]] x5 * [[Freeze Gland]] x5 | materials 2 = * [[Silver]] x15 | materials 3 = * [[Silver]] x30 | materials 4 = * [[Silver]] x60 | idol = * [[Silver Battle Idol]] | frost per level = 6 | blunt per level = 0 | stamina = 12 | block armor = 30 }} '''Frostner''' is the fourth one-handed [[Clubs|club]]. Its primary attack is a 3-hit combo with double damage on the last hit. Its slower secondary attack deals 2.5x damage and 2x staggering. Its very high knockback and [[Frost Effect|slow]] makes it a good choice for fighting multiple foes at once. These attributes in combination with different damage types make the Frostner a very effective all round weapon even in later biomes. == Upgrade information == {| class="wikitable" !Quality !1 !2 !3 !4 !Total |- !Blunt |35 |35 |35 |35 | |- !Frost |40 |46 |52 |58 | |- !Spirit |20 |20 |20 |20 | |- !Durability |200 |250 |300 |350 | |- !Crafting |10 [[Ancient Bark]]

5 [[Freeze Gland]] {{Upgrade station row|Forge|4|start=3|addcol=1}} |} * Frostner can also be upgraded at the [[Forge of Potential]] with a [[Silver Battle Idol]]. == Notes == * The [[Damage types#Frost|Frost]] damage is applied instantly, even though the slow persists over time. * The [[Damage types#Spirit|Spirit]] damage is applied over time (and only affects some enemies). * The hammer itself also gives off a Frost Aura, which is a purely visual effect. * The [[Wet Effect|Wet]] status causes Frost weakness, making the Frostner effective against enemies submerged in water (rain only affects players). * Players are less likely to see a foe stagger from damage from Frostner compared to other maces; this is because frost does not contribute to [[Stagger|staggering]], only physical damage does. * The knockback can be detrimental when focusing a target down, especially when playing in a group. Using the secondary attack to finish off the target may be preferred over primary attacks. * The combination of knockback and slowing effect provided by frost makes the Frostner optimal for crowd control. == Trivia == * Frostner's appearance is loosely based on archeological finds and artistic representations of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mj%C3%B6lnir Mjölnir], the one-handed hammer of Thor. {{Weapons}} [[Fr:Argivre]] [[cs:Frostner]] [[ru:Ледомор]] [[de:Frostner]]
